apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 256 MB–1 GB start.

sirene-card.eventDescription: Charged once per SUCCESSFUL French company card (SIREN/SIRET fetched and normalized: denomination, status, NAF/APE, address, établissements summary, Markdown card and optional RAG chunks). Invalid ids, not found, rate-limited after retries, auth errors and provider failures are free.
